Nina: Morning team — quick rollup: drop a 1-line yesterday / today / blocker. Main asks: spec for dynamic routing needs signoff, and the launch checklist has a couple config flags we need decided. @Jon @Priya
Jon: Yesterday: landed caching shim (PR #432). Today: investigating perf regression in staging after the shim. Blocker: flaky e2e that keeps failing on kv-evict test. @Luca can you take a look?
Priya: Yesterday: drafted the dynamic-routing spec and pushed updates to the doc (link: https://rwd/notes/dynamic-routing). Today: prototyping canary policy and preparing test prompts. Blocker: need realistic QA dataset — cc @Marta for any UX examples.
Luca: Yesterday: rotated GPUs on dedicated pool and applied infra patch for autoscaler. Today: will repro the e2e failure and check logs. If you can paste the failing CI job id I'll run a debug build.
Jon: CI job id: build-2026-03-17-1187. Repro steps: `kubectl -n staging logs -f pod/evict-tester` then run `./scripts/evict_test.sh --count 1000` — flakes show in ~30s.
Luca: Got it — starting a debug run now. If it repros I’ll snapshot the kernel traces and attach.
Marta: Yesterday: small polish on the prompt editor: moved the example snippets above the fold. Today: mockups for the onboarding tooltip ready. No blockers. For QA dataset I can extract ~120 UX examples from user sessions (anon) and drop to the staging bucket.
Nina: Prioritization note: finish dynamic-routing spec -> signoff -> canary rollout. If e2e flakes block canary, fallback plan is to delay canary and do a config flag toggle test on a tiny slice (see flag `enable_dynamic_route_v2`). Decision needed by EOD.
Jon: I can run the flag toggle test after Luca confirms the staging baseline. Will queue a short canary if infra is green.
Priya: For the spec signoff — I left 2 open questions in the doc about fallback behavior and metric thresholds. @Nina can you weigh in on thresholds (latency vs error-rate tradeoff)?
Nina: Suggest thresholds: latency p95 +10% over baseline and error-rate > 0.5% — whichever triggers first. I’ll add to the doc and mark for review.
Luca: Debug run repro'd the flake, attaching short log snippet:```
[evict] iter=42 status=fail reason=kv-evict-timeout
stack: runtime.go:234 -> evict.go:89 -> main.go
```
Luca: Root cause looks like a race in the eviction path under constant load. I’ll push a hotfix branch and run a canary against the minimal slice.
Jon: Thx. I’ll hold off the larger canary until hotfix is validated.
Marta: Dropping the QA examples to `s3://redwood-staging/qa/dynamic-routing/` in 30m.
Nina: OK — plan: (1) Luca pushes hotfix and runs mini-canary on slice-3, (2) Priya readies canary policy, (3) Marta drops QA data, (4) Jon coordinates staging verification. Callout: if hotfix fails, fallback = feature flag rollback. Ping here when mini-canary completes. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: nightly/staging deploy succeeded at 2026-03-17T06:12:00Z — images: rwd/runtime:2026.03.17-1
Jon: Noted, I’ll post the mini-canary result in this thread once Luca confirms.
